config.authorized_by: Gate M2 review: Rulings 24-26 + Stage M3 authorization

inputs.splits: experiments/m2_splits.json (frozen, seed 3210, reused per frozen section 5)
inputs.profiles: data/profiles.json (public profile, designed signal-free per section 2)

m2_normalization_constants.note: frozen at the M2 main fit; reused verbatim for every M3 phi_hat map

short_survey.draw: seed 3230; one seeded stratified permutation of the 104 training non-distractor scenarios (block-proportional interleave); nested prefixes give every K; the K=12 prefix realizes mode 5 / dep 3 / route 2 / policy 2; same scenarios for every traveler; no adaptive selection
short_survey.prior: Gaussian moments (mean, covariance + 1e-6 jitter) of the M2 EB-MAP (shrinkage_refit) coefficients over training travelers
short_survey.posterior: per-traveler MAP on the K noised round-0 answers; Laplace covariance = inverse negative Hessian at the MAP
short_survey.profile_role: unconditional prior (profile is designed signal-free); profile-group prior-mean deltas reported as the design check; profile-only baseline computed

brier_lift.bar: >= 25% Brier improvement over the population-marginal baseline on held-out choice prediction, K = 12 + profile
brier_lift.cells: held-out travelers x held-out non-distractor scenarios (26)
brier_lift.p_true: 50 seeded applications of the ratified noise layer, rounds 100-149, to the recorded pre-noise answers (frozen section 5, parent convention)
brier_lift.score: BS = mean over cells of sum_o (p_hat_o - p_true_o)^2
brier_lift.knn_beside: k = 20 nearest training travelers by exact-match agreement on the same K=12 answers; predicted shares = neighbours' round-0 shares

ece.convention: pooled option-level cells (p_hat_o vs realized round-0 choice indicator), 10 equal-width bins

coverage.sigma: 200 seeded Laplace draws (seed 3240) through the frozen anchor maps with the M2 normalization constants verbatim
coverage.decay: coverage per K over the k_grid, watched and reported (a finding, never a failure)

config.baseline_not_run: LLM-given-public-profile-only (frozen baseline 4) requires ~10.4k Gemini calls (~$0.8); NOT run under the zero-spend authorization; surfaced at the gate per the stop-first rule

elasticities_reported.role: REPORTED, no bar; the section 6 by-construction caveat verbatim in every table
elasticities_reported.data: round-0 noised choices, all 400 travelers (aggregate realism, non-confirmatory)

families.parking_driving_cost: 15 policy_prc scenarios, drive cost 5.58-11.65 EUR, transit alternative fixed; arc elasticity (midpoint formula) of population car share between cheapest and dearest; log-log OLS slope across all 15 as robustness
families.toll_take_up: 4 policy_vot scenarios vs toll level, same formulas
families.employer_subsidy: 6 policy_mod scenarios: uptake share vs time penalty; no price variation, no elasticity

published_ranges_cited.parking_car_cost: -0.1 to -0.4 (Goodwin, Dargay & Hanly 2004; Vaca & Kuzmyak 2005; Litman synthesis)
published_ranges_cited.transit_fare: -0.2 to -0.5 (TRL 2004; Litman) — recorded for the gap note only

elasticities_reported.gap: the design table's transit fare-change probe was never built into the bank; the fare-elasticity comparison cannot be computed and is reported as missing

aggregate_vs_individual.predictors: K=12 short-survey models of held-out travelers (mean predicted probability); M2 full-data models as context; population-marginal reference
aggregate_vs_individual.metrics: MAE in share points and Pearson r over cells, beside the individual recovery medians

ruling26_exploratory.label: EXPLORATORY - declared at M2-close (Ruling 26); cannot overturn frozen verdicts
estimators: frozen MNL as run at M2 (numbers from results/m2_recovery.json, not refit)
designed-score tendency index (grader-side oracle reference, from results/m2_diagnostics.json)
regularized variant: identical frozen utility and fit, ridge lambda = 1.0 (single pre-declared value); its PRC/HAB normalizations recomputed on training travelers
ruling26_exploratory.metrics: held-out per-dimension r + median; VOT median real-unit error for the two MNLs

config.cost: zero API calls; pure NumPy off cached material

profile_design_check.note: profile is designed signal-free; posterior uses the unconditional prior (pre-declared)

brier_lift.bar: >= 25% Brier improvement over the population-marginal baseline
brier_lift.llm_profile_baseline: LLM-given-public-profile-only (frozen baseline 4) requires ~10.4k Gemini calls (~$0.8); NOT run under the zero-spend authorization; surfaced at the gate per the stop-first rule

coverage.bar: pooled 60-75% at K = 12 (1 Laplace-draw SD, held-out x 6 dims)
coverage.note: decay watched and reported per the frozen bar; a finding, never a failure

elasticities_reported.caveat: By-construction caveat (frozen section 6, verbatim): the population's planted VOT/PRC distributions partly determine these numbers; the comparison is a realism check, never recovery evidence.
elasticities_reported.role: REPORTED realism check; no bar (frozen section 6)
elasticities_reported.data: round-0 noised choices, all 400 travelers (non-confirmatory aggregate)

parking_driving_cost.published_range: -0.1 to -0.4 (Goodwin, Dargay & Hanly 2004; Vaca & Kuzmyak 2005; Litman)

toll_take_up.note: time savings co-vary 16-21 min across the 4 scenarios (price per saved minute 0.20-0.23 EUR); stated per the pre-declaration

employer_subsidy_uptake.note: no price variation in this family; no elasticity

elasticities_reported.transit_fare_gap: the design table's fare-change probe was never built into the bank; the fare elasticity vs the published -0.2 to -0.5 range cannot be computed and is reported as missing

aggregate_vs_individual.reading: the parent's aggregate-easy/individual-hard question, answered for mobility

ruling26_exploratory_comparison.label: EXPLORATORY - declared at M2-close (Ruling 26); cannot overturn frozen verdicts

llm_profile_baseline_ruling29.role: frozen section 5 baseline 4 (LLM given public profile, no choices), Ruling 29; reported beside the lift bar
